title: AED Installation in New Estates Such as Tengah
what_it_is: AED Installation in New Estates Such as Tengah

sections.label: AED installation in Tengah estate
sections.summary: Twenty-nine AEDs are installed in Tengah, 11 more by February 2026, covering about 70% of HDB blocks with residents, with CCTVs to deter theft.

sentences.speaker: Dr Choo Pei Ling
sentences.text: asked the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs (a) what preparatory steps are required before Automated External Defibrillators (AEDs) can be installed in newly developed estates such as Tengah; (b) what is the estimated timeline for AED installation in Tengah estate, and how it compares with other HDB precincts; and (c) what interim measures are in place to support emergency preparedness in new estates pending AED deployment.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: This includes having closed-circuit televisions (CCTVs) in the vicinity to deter AED theft.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Twenty-nine AEDs have been installed in Tengah estate to date; 11 more will be installed by February 2026.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: This will cover about 70% of the Housing and Development Board (HDB) blocks in Tengah where residents have already moved in.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: To equip residents with fire safety knowledge and life-saving skills, SCDF organises community emergency preparedness events, such as Community Resilience Days and MyNiceHome roadshows, in partnership with the People's Association and HDB.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Several of these events have already been held in Tengah in recent months.

sections.label: Community partnership for life-saving skills
sections.summary: The speaker encourages the community to work with Community Emergency and Engagement Committees to partner SCDF in organising life-saving skills programmes.

sentences.speaker: Dr Choo Pei Ling (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Timely access to life-saving equipment, like AEDs, is critical.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: And at the same time, I also encourage the community to work very closely with their Community Emergency and Engagement Committees, because they can also partner SCDF in organising activities and programmes that help to equip residents with life-saving skills.
